definitions.description: No equal normalized stored program/context or high-confidence timing-only/palette-distance near match; meaningful geometry, directions, axes and modes remain distinct. This is the existing 6,074-entry unit.

Collapse effects that share a motion principle even when icon geometry, direction, style or colors differ. Existing 1,214 Material Line Icons and other families cannot each be assumed unique motion principles.
Whole source composition, time-normalized frames and interaction states compared across CSS, SVG, JavaScript/Lottie and shaders. Code equality alone cannot determine perceptual equivalence.
definitions.currentCoverage: not performed across every frame and implementation

localConstraints.finding: Count complete independent assets and canonical novelty clusters. Do not count aliases, component parts, file formats, generated option combinations, mirrored providers, private/premium download claims, inaccessible source or links as new stored assets.

Compare candidates against all current canonical originals, variants, aliases and repair.originalRecord, plus candidates from other new sources. Comparing only top-level canonical code misses previously merged original arrays/programs.

Current preview supports safe CSS composition, animated SVG, palettes/gradients and GL Transitions-style GLSL using transition(v_uv). It has no arbitrary JavaScript/React/Lottie host or Shadertoy mainImage/multipass adapter.

An engine's MIT license does not automatically cover showcase designs, downloaded animations, external textures/fonts/models/music or generator presets. Each asset needs reproducible source, license and complete dependencies.

robots.txt or browser access describes a retrieval path; it does not grant redistribution or competing-library rights. This feasibility review does not count material whose raw distribution rights are absent.

confidenceGate.verdictNow: Do not promise 3,926 new unique canonical entries or 4,214 new stored assets solely from marketplace advertising. Raw market is large; qualifying net stock quantity remains unproved in this review.
confidenceGate.phase2StartGate: Enumerate a real, legally obtainable source-bearing candidate inventory; deduplicate providers/forks and normalized candidate clusters before yield sampling. Keep current audited counting unit explicit.
confidenceGate.sampling: Within each provider/format/family stratum, randomly select representative whole candidates using a recorded seed. Check license/source/dependencies, safe runnable preview, original composition, all baseline originals and cross-source novelty. Do not select only impressive showcase examples.
confidenceGate.formula: For stratum h with enumerated canonical candidate clusters N_h, use a one-sided Wilson lower bound L_h for its qualified proportion. Choose simultaneous 95% coverage using alpha_h=0.05/H (Bonferroni over H strata). Proceed to target expansion only when sum_h floor(N_h * L_h) >= 3,926 canonical entries, or >= 4,214 for stored-assets target. This is a forecast gate, not a promise of zero final rejection.
confidenceGate.sampleSizeRule: Continue stratified sampling until the lower-bound total clears the selected target or upper-bound total falls short. If a precision target is required, choose a stated error tolerance first and derive sample size from z^2/(4*epsilon^2); do not fix an arbitrary 300-sample threshold or assume a 70% acceptance rate.
confidenceGate.releaseGate: Every admitted asset still undergoes final exact/near checks and source/license/composition review. Unresolved high-similarity candidates are deferred or merged; final count is measured after consolidation.
confidenceGate.strictInterpretationGate: If 'similar' also excludes any shared effect principle or visually related family, rebaseline current 6,074 before estimating. Palette and icon inventory is not evidence of 10,000 unrelated motion mechanisms.
